title: Totality
alt: A total solar eclipse: the black disc of the moon surrounded by a bright white ring of the sun's corona against a dark blue sky.
caption: The total solar eclipse of April 8, 2024: a few minutes when the sky went dark and the sun's corona finally showed itself.

title: Marry me
alt: Two people holding hands and laughing in a white gazebo beneath giant gold balloon letters spelling MARRY ME, with red rose petals scattered across the floor and a winter field behind them. One wears a dark green velvet dress; the other wears a tan coat and green bow tie.
caption: The moment right after the question: hands held, both of them laughing beneath the gold balloons.

title: Best friends
alt: Two happy dogs with their mouths open: a sleek black greyhound wearing a yellow bee-patterned collar, and a fluffy golden dog looking up beside it.
caption: Two very good dogs sharing the same happy grin.

title: Light columns
alt: Night photo where lights have streaked vertically into tall glowing golden columns of different heights against a black sky, each topped with a bright wavy line of light, with blurred gold reflections along the bottom.
caption: Taken at the University of Maine while experimenting with exposure: a 1/6-second shutter let the lights stretch into glowing columns. It received an award at the 2017 Juried Student Art Exhibition in Lord Hall Gallery.

title: Cookie
alt: Black-and-white close-up of a grey and white cat with small folded ears peeking in from the lower left corner, its eyes the only color in the photo: a vivid glowing green. The background is a soft grey blur.
caption: My cat, Cookie. I turned the photo black and white and kept only those green eyes in color.

title: Ahhhh
alt: Two giant anteaters standing side by side in front of an ivy-covered brick wall, their long grey snouts pointing toward the camera.
caption: Two giant anteaters side by side, looking about as surprised to see me as I was to see them.

title: Chickadee
alt: Black-and-white photo of a small chickadee perched on top of a rounded stone, with a softly blurred background.
caption: A chickadee paused on a stone just long enough for one frame. Black and white keeps the focus on its shape.

title: Comfy
alt: A shaggy black binturong with long white whiskers resting its chin on the edge of a hammock, eyes half closed.
caption: A binturong, also called a bearcat, settled into its hammock and completely unbothered by the camera.

title: A boy and his dog
alt: A bearded man with glasses in a red T-shirt smiling down at a fluffy golden puppy he is holding, against a clear blue sky.
caption: A quiet moment between a golden puppy and the person holding it, under a clear blue sky.

title: Grammy
alt: An older woman with white curly hair and tinted glasses laughing, wearing a magenta shirt, with dark green trees behind her.
caption: Grammy, caught mid-laugh. This is the kind of moment I wait for.

title: Gramps
alt: Side profile of an older man with white hair and sunglasses in a light blue shirt, looking down, with a blurred green forest behind him.
caption: Gramps, lost in thought on a green summer afternoon.

title: Family
alt: A large family group outdoors in front of tall trees and a small red-and-white lighthouse model, with an older couple seated in lawn chairs at the front.
caption: The whole family together, with Grammy and Gramps in the front row.

title: Graduation day
alt: Black-and-white photo of a crowd of graduates in caps and gowns, seen from behind, with one smiling graduate turned toward the camera waving.
caption: In a sea of black caps and gowns, one graduate turns back to wave.
